ruling.recommended_action: Route to Ryde Trust & Safety for human review of the rider's threat; preserve the in-app chat (18:24:05 driver request, 18:24:35 rider threat) and the driver's statement; no automatic fare adjustment; contact the driver to confirm he is safe and remind him of the RydeHELP reporting path (and 995 if he feels unsafe), and note the rider's smoking-in-vehicle conduct issue for the rider side.
ruling.reasoning: Safety screen: dispute type is "safety" and the record itself contains a threat. The in-app chat shows the driver, at 18:24:05, sending "Please do not smoke in the car.", and the rider at 18:24:35 replying "Say that again and I will punch you." The driver's statement is consistent: he asked the passenger not to smoke and was told he would be punched if he said it again; he kept driving and did not respond. Read in context this is not a pickup arrangement or banter — it is a direct threat of physical violence aimed at the driver, i.e. a threat/intimidation and abuse of a person on the platform. Under SAFE-1 the judge must not issue an automated ruling: ruling = escalate, safety_concern = "confirmed". (Nothing in the record supports a driving-safety or injury allegation, so SAFE-2 is not relied on; there is no route-deviation, no-show, waiting-fee or fare issue in this case, so RD/NS/FARE clauses do not apply and no amount is computed. Both profiles are clean — rider disputes_90d 0, driver disputes_90d 0 — so RD-6/NS-2 account-flag conditions are not met and no flag_account is attached.) Evidence status: sufficient for the safety finding (both chat messages are timestamped and the statement corroborates), and the escalation is solely mandated by SAFE-1, not by any missing record.
ruling.escalation_reason: Threat of physical violence (threatened assault) by the rider against the driver, evidenced in the in-app chat; SAFE-1 requires escalation to a human reviewer instead of an automated ruling.
